messages:
Harper (People Ops): Quick thread: Sofia (new SWE) is EU-based and her passport renewal delayed. Start date next Mon. We need I-9 verification and day-1 laptop. Options?
Ibrahim (Hiring Manager): We prefer keeping the start. Team can do remote onboarding.
Sofia (New Hire): I can visit a local notary or an embassy office. Also internet is unreliable; would need a loaner for first week.
Harper (People Ops): Notary is fine. We require an Agent Authorization form signed, plus photo uploads to secure intake. Sending template now.
notary-bot: Sofia, secure upload link: https://redwood-internal/onboard-upload (expires in 72h).
Sofia (New Hire): Uploaded passport scan and renewal receipt. Notary name: "Notaria Plaza, Barcelona".
Kai (IT): We can ship a loaner laptop. Need shipping addr and confirmation to use courier (DHL). Typical ETA 48-72 hrs.
Sofia (New Hire): Shipping: Carrer de Balmes 101, 3, 08008 Barcelona, Spain. DHL OK.
Harper (People Ops): I'll approve agent route. Action items: 1) Sofia to complete notary visit and Agent form; 2) IT to ship loaner (ticket IT-5699); 3) Benefits walkthrough scheduled after orientation; 4) Payroll to send tax/residency forms.
Ibrahim (Hiring Manager): I'll send calendar invites for orientation and 1:1. Please confirm once the loaner ships.
Kai (IT): Loaner request submitted (IT-5699). Marked express. Tracking to come.
Sofia (New Hire): Thanks all  excited to join!
notary-bot: Reminder: "Sign Agent Authorization" scheduled +1 day.
